PHL.scope: Philippines national government revenue, 1996 (DBM/DBCC fiscal operations): revenues P410.4bn, disbursements P404.2bn, surplus P6.3bn; 26.2 pesos per US$. Totals and the tax/non-tax/capital/current splits are sourced; lines below them are estimated.

mechs.name: Personal income tax
mechs.note: Graduated income tax, 1996 schedule roughly 1% to 35%; approximate brackets. Revenue split estimated.

mechs.name: Corporate income tax
mechs.note: 35% corporate income tax in 1996. Revenue split estimated.

mechs.name: Value-added tax
mechs.note: 10% VAT (reformed in 1988, rate 10%); many exemptions and a large evasion gap. Revenue split estimated.

mechs.name: Excise taxes
mechs.note: Excises on tobacco, alcohol, petroleum and autos. Revenue split estimated.

mechs.name: Customs duties
mechs.note: Bureau of Customs import duties; average tariff falling under the 1991-95 tariff reform. Revenue estimated.

mechs.name: Other taxes
mechs.note: Stamp, estate and donor's, percentage and other taxes; residual of the P367.894bn tax total.

mechs.name: Non-tax revenue
mechs.note: Fees, charges, central bank and other non-tax income (sourced, P36.895bn).
